rows.note: Use this for a bunch of linked or fastened items, especially grapes.

example.english: This bunch of grapes is very sweet.
example.jyutping: ni1 jat1 cyun3 pou4 tou4 hou2 tim4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for a large amount or loose pile, such as a bunch of trouble.

example.english: There is a bunch of paperwork on the desk.
example.jyutping: toi2 min6 jau5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for an informal group of people, especially friends.

example.english: A bunch of friends are going out to eat tonight.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 jat1 baan1 pang4 jau5 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when bunch means several people or things rather than a cohesive group.

example.english: There are a bunch of people at the door.
example.jyutping: mun4 hau2 jau5 gei2 go3 jan4
